# Extractor emits Facts only

An Extractor turns artifacts into Fact IR and must not emit Entity objects (docstring: 'Never emits entities (ADR-009)').

Maintain a clear separation between fact extraction and entity construction so downstream stages can rely on a stable IR shape.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/interfaces.py` — `knowledge_compiler.interfaces.Extractor.extract`
